content_en.prompt: Necklace beads (S=star, T=triangle, R=rectangle, L=line) can be compactly described: identical consecutive beads → count+letter; a repeating sequence → repetition count + sequence in parentheses; otherwise just the letter. E.g. one necklace can be described as S3(TR)3SL (length 9, 9 symbols).
content_en.question: How many symbols are in the shortest representation for a given necklace (a symbol is a digit, letter, or parenthesis)?
content_en.explanation: Several valid representations exist depending on how the repeated pattern is chosen (e.g. star-triangle vs triangle-star); the shortest ones use 13 symbols (e.g. S2RT3S3(ST)4L).
content_en.ct_explanation: This relates to data compression: designing techniques to store data using the least memory while being able to recover the original exactly. All such techniques identify redundancy and represent it more compactly — exactly what happens here when repeated beads are shortened instead of written out explicitly.

content_zh.prompt: 項鍊珠子（S=星形、T=三角形、R=長方形、L=線形）可以用精簡方式描述：連續相同的珠子→數量+字母；重複出現的序列→重複次數+用括號括起來的序列；其他情況就直接寫字母。例如某條項鍊可以描述成S3(TR)3SL(長度9，共9個符號)。
content_zh.question: 某條項鍊最精簡的描述方式，總共需要幾個符號（符號指數字、字母或括號）？
content_zh.explanation: 依照重複樣式的選法不同（例如星-三角 vs 三角-星），有好幾種有效的表示法；最精簡的用13個符號就能表示（例如S2RT3S3(ST)4L）。
content_zh.cs_domain: 系統性列舉、計數與推理
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這跟資訊科學裡的「資料壓縮」有關：設計技術用最少的記憶體儲存資料，同時還能完整還原原始資料。所有這類技術的共通點，就是找出資料裡的重複性、用更精簡的方式表示它——這正是這一題把重複的珠子縮寫，而不是逐一列出時發生的事。
